from pathlib import Path

source='''def transform(grid):
    h = len(grid)
    if h == 0:
        return []
    row_order = list(range(h - 1, -1, -1)) + list(range(h)) + list(range(h - 1, -1, -1))
    out = []
    for r in row_order:
        row = list(grid[r])
        out.append(row[::-1] + row)
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'), globals())
